title: T-minus 48h owner commitment tracker
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad to capture last-48h checkpoints and owner commitments for the release train go/no-go sync. Keep terse — used during standups and handoffs.

Context notes (quick):
- Release window: 2025-09-30 22:00 UTC (2h deploy window).
- Primary feature: routing policy update + canary weights + kernel selection tweak.
- Hard SLOs: median latency < 120ms; error rate < 0.5% post-rollout.

Major risk areas I want checked in the morning:
- Canary config correctness (weights, region targets).
- Autoscaler warmup (dedicated pools) + reserved capacity confirmed.
- KV cache priming for hot prompts (prefix cache TTL).
- Rollback path validated and exercised in staging.
- Housekeeping: infra quotas (GCE/GPU), KMS rotation not in-flight.

Owner commitments (T-48 -> T-0 timeframe):
- Ben Carter (infra): confirm reserved capacity + run warmup script by 2025-09-29 18:00 UTC. Command used + screenshot of pool sizes. Action: post screenshot to #release-ops.
- Marta Alvarez (serving-runtime): validate canary weight config and compatibility with new kernel selection; test a 5% canary in canary-cluster by 2025-09-29 22:00 UTC. Add canary metrics dashboard link to this doc.
- Liam O'Reilly (sre): smoke test checklist pass (trace sampling, error rate gating), run smoke on canary at T-24 and T-6; if any test fails, escalate to oncall and call rollback.
- Aisha Kapoor (release lead / me): coordinate go/no-go, update stakeholders, publish final roll decision 1h before window. Prepare comms snippet for customers + internal status.
- QA (TBA): perf regression quick-run (50-concurrent users, 5-min window) against canary and baseline; results to be in #qa-results by T-12.

Quick checklist (tick at sync):
- [ ] Canary job scheduled + manifest pinned (owner + timestamp)
- [ ] Metrics alerts updated for new kernel (latency/error)
- [ ] Rollback job pre-created and sanity-checked in cluster
- [ ] DB migrations (none) confirmed — no schema changes included
- [ ] Secrets / KMS: no key rotations planned during window
- [ ] Oncall rota for 4h post-deploy confirmed

Fallback / rollback plan (concise):
- Immediate action: switch routing policy to previous variant (pre-09-29) and drop canary weight to 0%.
- Infra rollback: scale down new kernel nodes and route to stable pool (Ben + Infra runbook step 3).
- Communication: short internal status update + decision to customers if >10% error or >30% perf regress.

Open questions / things to resolve (notes-to-self):
- Is the canary metric set exhaustive enough? Need to add "median p99 response time per model" to gating. (Marta -> add to dashboard)
- We should confirm that dedupe cache doesn't create cold-start spike when we prime caches — schedule a 10-min soak on staging.
- Who owns marketplace revert notifications? (Ping product ops)

Meeting prep bullets for the T-minus-48h sync (what I'll ask each owner):
- Confirm checklist items are green and show proof (screenshots / links).
- If any item is amber, what is the mitigation and ETA?
- Who will be on the deploy bridge and where (Zoom + #release-ops)?
- What is the rollback trigger threshold (exact metric + duration)?

Action log (running):
- 2025-09-28 09:10 UTC — Ben: reserved capacity OK; posted pool sizes screenshot.
- 2025-09-29 08:05 UTC — Marta: canary manifest prepared, pending canary run.
- 2025-09-29 12:30 UTC — Liam: updated smoke tests with p99 checks (added to jira REL-1123).

Stuff to paste into the meeting:
- One-liner for execs: "Deploying routing-policy + kernel tweak on 2025-09-30 22:00 UTC. Expected perf gain on long-tail sequences; rollback plan in place. Oncall coverage confirmed."
- Customer comms snippet: short outage notice template + expected impact list (only metadata: cost-per-token unchanged; transient latency blips possible).

Personal reminders:
- Bring laptop charger.
- Set calendar alert 1h prior to publish final go/no-go.

End of scratchpad. Will keep updating until T=0.
